description: Execution contract for a critical synthesis of theory: reconstruct the theories, their constructs, assumptions and mechanisms; compare them and their scopes; identify possible tensions; look for literature that already recognises or resolves each tension; only then propose reconceptualisations for the researcher's review. It has no data-collection or estimation stage and fixes no method content. Independent of discipline. Status EXTRACTED: nothing here is verified.

methods.justification: a critical synthesis collects and estimates nothing; its analytic steps (reconstruction, comparison, tension-finding, recognition search) are in the literature stage

results.justification: a critical synthesis has no separate empirical results stage; what it reports is the reconstruction and the tensions, in the literature and discussion stages

steps.title: Reconstruct the relevant theories from full text

evidence_requirements.about: a landscape built from a current reading list

steps.title: Reconstruct constructs, stated assumptions and explanatory mechanisms
Compare the theories and their scopes, units and levels of analysis
Identify possible conceptual or theoretical tensions (proposals the researcher decides on)
Search for literature that already recognises or resolves each tension

on_condition.reason: a reviewed paper already addresses the tension: restate it against that paper or drop it

steps.title: Propose possible reconceptualisations for the researcher's review

applicability.justification: reconceptualisation is the purpose of a critical synthesis or of theory development
